record_error_uids: record a list of item UIDs as errored in the SQLite advisory error registry
get_error_uids: get the subset of item UIDs that have previously errored from the error registry
get_all_errors: get all item UIDs currently marked as errored in the SQLite error registry
clear_error_uids: clear and remove specific item UIDs from the SQLite error registry database
review_error_registry: review the ErrorRegistry class and its SQLite-based presence-only index for failed cache items
